title: Not Worth $32  what JOKE- Price goes UP, Quality Goes DOWN....
text: Not Worth $32  what JOKE- Price goes UP, Quality Goes DOWN..... I paid $26.00 for this 3 months ago. It is nothing like the older version which was Cotton Terry Cloth with seeds or rice which was wonderful. I still have one of the old terry cloth ones and it was great. This new version of clay beads with smaller Flammable polyestor fabric is not even close.  This cover is total junk. I tried to gently wash it and after that and drying it, the tiny closure of velcro titally melted into nothing but a gummy mess. Ot now has no closure on it.  I tried to ask the company for a refund or replacement but they were rude and gave ZERO help. I WON't buy this brand anymore. I used to get this brand but it must have sold out or moved to China, not ssure why, but Quality has gone WAY DOWN.  It is not worth more than maybe 14.95 if you are desperate for a short term heating pillow. Cheap junk.  Clay beads are hard and uncomfortable and sometimes prickily.  When I opened it up there was stuff also that looked liked tinys bits of weeds or something...
